blurb:
Visit Miami with our Exclusive Tour

Discover the many facets of Miami with this guided live tour. The expert guide-chauffeur will take you through the history and current life of the city on a shared tour with small groups, giving you a more personal and exclusive experience.

This 4-hour tour includes stops at:

Wynwood: Urban art (15-20 minutes)
- Chapel of the Virgin of Charity of the Patron Copper of Cuba (15 minutes)
-Little Havana (45 minutes to 1 hour)

What distinguishes us from most tours in Miami is exploring lesser-known areas such as Coconut Grove and Coral Gables, plus popular destinations Miami Beach, Downtown and Wynwood.

We finish in Little Havana, where you can choose between staying and exploring on your own or returning to the pickup point in downtown Miami.
Join us and experience a unique experience that combines the best of the city with a touch of exclusivity!
* Children under 5 years old are not allowed.
